app.title: Postpartum Care Companion
app.tagline: Record, reflect and find support at your own pace

auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Log in

disclaimer.title: Product disclaimer
disclaimer.short: This app supports everyday care records and questions. AI responses can be incorrect. It does not diagnose, treat or provide an emergency response. Discuss medical concerns with a professional; in Japan, call 119 if you need an ambulance.

welcome.title: A little help with everyday care
welcome.subtitle: You're not alone at 3am
welcome.description: Start with a record or a question, at your own pace.
welcome.feature1: Start a conversation from a specific situation
welcome.step2Title: Tell us what you feel comfortable sharing
welcome.step2Subtitle: This helps us provide personalized support
welcome.step3Note1: This app provides general information, not medical diagnosis
welcome.step3Note2: Always consult healthcare professionals for medical concerns
welcome.step3Note3: Review the information before sharing it
welcome.step3Note4: You can update your information anytime in settings

dashboard.insightText: Records alone cannot establish health status. Discuss concerns with a care professional.
dashboard.insightSubtext: It is okay to miss a day of recording.

chat.initialMessage: Choose a situation or write a short question. We can help you organize what to ask next.
chat.placeholder: Write what is on your mind

tracking.title: Daily care records
tracking.noEntries: No entries yet. Add your first entry to get started!

charts.title: Trends & Analytics
charts.noDataSubtext: Start tracking to see your patterns!

nightMode.title: Night support
nightMode.subtitle: Short responses and support contacts. This is not an emergency service.
nightMode.placeholder: What do you need help with right now?
nightMode.emergencyText: In Japan, call 119 for an ambulance. Do not wait for an AI response.

checkin.title: Reflect on how you feel
checkin.subtitle: A place to reflect on how you feel. This does not diagnose or assess your health.
checkin.overwhelmed: How difficult do things feel right now?
checkin.sharePlaceholder: Share only what you feel comfortable sharing
checkin.assessment: A response to help you reflect
checkin.disclaimerNonClinical: For support and reflection only. This is not a clinical or medical assessment.
checkin.safetyNote: Remember: This is not a substitute for professional mental health care. If you're experiencing thoughts of self-harm or harm to your baby, please contact emergency services immediately.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your preferences and information
settings.privacyNote: Records are stored on the operator’s server. Using AI sends your input and relevant context to an external AI service. See Support for retention information and a contact for deletion requests.

export.title: Export Your Data
export.subtitle: Download your tracking data for backup or sharing with healthcare providers
export.tipText: Exported data includes all your tracking entries. You can share this with your healthcare provider.

notifications.title: Notifications & Reminders
notifications.subtitle: Get reminders for feeding, check-ins, and more
notifications.noReminders: No reminders set. Add one to get started!
notifications.info: Enable notifications to receive helpful reminders for:

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Learn how to get the most out of Postpartum AI Copilot
help.contact: If you have questions or concerns, please:
help.consultProvider: Consult your healthcare provider for medical questions
help.contactPSI: Check your municipality or your usual healthcare provider for local support.

pilot.eyebrow: For families and small community services
pilot.entryTitle: Support for daily care and your own rest
pilot.entryDescription: Start with a record, a specific question or a support contact. No AI experience needed.
pilot.familyDescription: Keep track of baby care and your own wellbeing at your own pace.
pilot.familyBenefit1: Simple feeding, diaper and sleep records
pilot.familyBenefit2: Choose a question from a familiar situation
pilot.familyBenefit3: Find support and prepare records for a conversation
pilot.organizationDescription: Help families get started through a midwifery practice or community service.
pilot.organizationBenefit1: Provide a link to the family entrance
pilot.organizationBenefit2: Maintain local contacts and opening hours
pilot.organizationBenefit3: Family records are not automatically shared
pilot.entryPrivacy: You can record care without AI. Avoid entering unnecessary names, addresses or other identifying information.
pilot.familyAuthNote: Sign in to save your own records. Support contacts are available without signing in.
pilot.organizationAuthNote: The operator grants directory editing access. Registration alone does not grant it.
pilot.todayIntro: Save a record or ask a question. Start with what feels manageable.
pilot.askDescription: Choose a situation and start with a short question
pilot.findHelpDescription: Find a contact or a local support service
pilot.noPressure: It is okay to miss a day. Record only what is useful to you.
pilot.japanTime: Dates and times are shown in Japan Standard Time (JST).

questions.crying: My baby keeps crying. Help me organize what to check and what to tell a care professional. Ask me for any details you need.
questions.feeding: I have a feeding question. Ask one question at a time to help me explain the situation.
questions.rest: I feel tired and need some rest. Help me think through my situation and what I could ask someone to help with.
questions.appointment: I am preparing to speak with a midwife or healthcare professional. Help me organize my questions.

pilot.guidedChatIntro: Choose a situation to fill in a question. Review it before sending.
pilot.chatBoundary: AI responses can be incorrect. This does not provide diagnosis or emergency care. Contact a support service directly if you need urgent help.
pilot.aiNotice: Sending uses the external AI provider configured by the operator to process your input and relevant profile or records. Ask the operator about storage and data handling.
pilot.aiConsent: I understand that this feature processes information with an external AI provider
pilot.aiLabel: AI-generated response. This does not indicate review by a care professional.
pilot.chatUnavailable: A response is unavailable. Try again later, or contact a care service directly for urgent concerns.
pilot.checkinUnavailable: A reflection response is unavailable. Your health status has not been assessed.
pilot.nightUnavailable: AI support is unavailable. Use the contacts above. In Japan, call 119 directly if you need an ambulance.
pilot.reachOut: If things feel difficult, reach out to someone you trust or a care professional.
pilot.supportIntro: Support contacts for Japan, available without waiting for AI.
pilot.emergencyDescription: For ambulance and fire services in Japan, call 119.
pilot.childAdviceDescription: Child medical telephone advice: #8000. Opening hours vary by prefecture.
pilot.checkHours: Check hours with the Ministry of Health
pilot.ambulanceAdvice: Unsure about urgent care or an ambulance?
pilot.ambulanceAdviceDescription: #7119 availability, eligible ages and hours vary by area. Check your location first.
pilot.checkCoverage: Check coverage with the Fire and Disaster Management Agency
pilot.noLocalSupport: No local service has been configured yet. Contact your usual provider or municipality.
pilot.directoryUnavailable: Local information is unavailable. The national contacts above remain available.
pilot.noMonitoring: This app does not automatically notify or send requests to the organization. Check opening hours and contact them directly.
pilot.retentionUnknown: Ask the operator about retention periods and how to request deletion.
pilot.checkedOn: Date the operator checked the information
pilot.directoryNote: Local information is maintained by the operator. Confirm current fees, eligibility and hours at the linked source.
pilot.organizationScope: Manage this deployment’s public information here. This workspace does not provide access to families’ chats, feelings or health records.
pilot.accessInstructions: Give the operator your account ID below to request directory editing access. Choosing this entrance or matching an email address does not grant access.
pilot.familyLinkDescription: Give this link to families. Each person creates their own account. Using the link does not share their records with the organization.
pilot.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the displayed link.
pilot.publicFields: These fields are publicly visible without login. Use business contacts only and do not enter families’ personal information.
pilot.name: Organization name
pilot.retentionHelp: Describe actual retention periods, the contact and the deletion request process. Saving this text does not implement automatic deletion.

resource.name: Resource name
resource.checked_on: Date you actually checked the information

pilot.sourceReviewReminder: Check the content and source before publishing. A checked date does not imply clinical review.
pilot.saveFailed: Unable to save your settings. Check your input and try again.
pilot.loadFailed: Unable to load. Please try again later.
pilot.shortWelcome: Records, questions and support contacts. Use only what helps you.
pilot.optionalProfile: Everything is optional. Start with a nickname, or leave all fields empty.
pilot.recordFailed: Unable to save. Your input is still here; please try again.
pilot.summaryTitle: Prepare records for a care conversation
pilot.summaryDescription: Prepare the last seven days of feeding, diaper, sleep and pumping records. Chats and account details are excluded. Nothing is sent automatically to an organization.
pilot.includeParent: Also include my mood and physical recovery records (optional)
pilot.includeNotes: Also include free-text notes (check for personal information)
pilot.summaryHeader: Care conversation records (JST; not a diagnosis or assessment)
pilot.noSummaryEntries: There are no records of the selected types.
pilot.summarySharingNote: After downloading, choose who to give the file to. This app cannot revoke copies you have already shared.
